segments.caption: Moniq — Spending, Made Smarter. Alex is a synthetic Georgia State student; these totals are calculated from SQLite records.
A simulated $15.75 Chick-fil-A alert is extracted and classified Food by the local TF-IDF model. Review comes before saving; no automatic iMessage access.
Confirmation saved the expense and refreshed the dashboard and food budget. Weekly and monthly limits can be edited independently.
A $150 purchase reduces the estimated 30-day balance by exactly $150. Known bills and income are counted on due dates; forecasts remain estimates.
Offers match spending, interests, student eligibility and remaining budget. These are clearly labeled synthetic examples, not redeemable discounts.
The local assistant explains affordability using the same calculated forecast, with visible evidence. No external API key or invented financial numbers.
Monthly recurring services are inferred from three similar charges; review or dismiss detections. Confirmation does not cancel a subscription.
Transactions can be imported, searched, edited and deleted. This purchase is now a persisted record.
Profile, allowance and goals are editable. Export, delete and Reset Demo work. Moniq helps students see the consequence of everyday choices.
